Hi Vivek / Laura,

Please find attached the final penetration test report for Epsilon Financial (engagement EPS-2027-03). The PDF includes an executive summary, technical findings, and remediation recommendations. We also attached an appendix spreadsheet with reproduced PoCs and remediation status columns.

High-level: 3 critical, 6 high, 10 medium, 14 low. The critical items are:
- CVE-2026-XXXX: auth bypass in legacy SSO connector (repro + exploit steps in appendix)
- Unrestricted S3 read ACL on an analytics bucket containing PII
- Remote code execution via deserialization in batch ingestion service

We flagged recommended mitigations and suggested timelines in the recommendations section. Please confirm receipt and let us know if you'd like us to walk through the report with your engineering teams.

Attachments: epsilon-pt-2027-03-report.pdf (pdf), pt-findings-appendix.xlsx (xlsx)

+1 on the timeline. Quick triage notes (initial pass):

Critical items (need immediate attention):
1) CVE-2026-XXXX — SSO connector auth bypass: owner: @priyom_das/team-auth; action: rollback connector to previous safe version + disable federated login for Epsilon as a temporary mitigation; ETA for patch: 3 business days (hotfix).
2) S3 read ACL — owner: @priyom_das/team-storage; action: apply bucket policy deny for public/anonymous read, run object ACL audit; ETA: 2 business days to mitigate, 5 business days for full data scan and validation.
3) RCE in ingestion — owner: @priyom_das/team-ingest (lead: Priyom); action: deploy ruleset to WAF and enable strict deserialization checks; ETA: 5 business days for rule rollout, 10 days for service update.

Data gathering requests from my side (I need these to validate PoCs and close findings):
- Full access logs for the ingestion service for March 1–7 (kept in GCS: project-redwood-prod / logs/ingest/)
- S3 ACL listing for analytics buckets + object metadata export (we need object create timestamps and ACL entries)
- Docker image manifest and hashes for the batch ingestion service (CI artifact store link)

I will create a shared folder (linked below) and populate a tracker with the findings mapped to owners. Monica, can you create the remediation ticket template we want eng to use?

Laura
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
